neighbours.label: the continuation piece that completes a number word or compound split by the tokenizer (one-six|th, wordpress|.com)
fire: The will left one-sixth of the farm to each grandchild.
Roughly one-sixth of the budget goes to roads.
He sold one-sixth of his shares last spring.
A sixth of the crew fell ill on the voyage.
The pie was cut so that each guest got one-sixth.
Only a sixth of the class passed the final exam.
They paid royalties of one-sixth on every barrel.
Nearly one-sixth of the island is protected forest.
quiet: The will left one half of the farm to each grandchild.
Roughly one quarter of the budget goes to roads.
He sold some of his shares last spring.
A few of the crew fell ill on the voyage.
The pie was cut so that each guest got one slice.
Only a handful of the class passed the final exam.
They paid royalties of ten percent on every barrel.
Nearly half of the island is protected forest.

notes: top examples are mixed (th, .com, /M, digits); only 'one-sixth' fired in probing
